shared_elements: framing border line running around the edge of the field
small panels/cartouches containing signs or motifs set into the border
linear incised design in a central field
justification: The only real correspondence is a formal one: both surfaces have a design enclosed by a border line, with small framed panels containing signs or motifs set into that border, and both include incised linear detail in the central field. But A depicts a detailed, modelled winged anthropomorphic figure in profile with raised arm beside a stylised rosette-plant, while B shows only a faint schematic outline of a squarish handled object and a grid, with no figures, animals or plants at all — the manner of depiction (rich naturalistic relief versus bare thin outline) is likewise unrelated.
